Recursive validation had no independent node or depth bound and could admit oversized lists or raise RecursionError before the bridge's 4096-node scanner regained control.
honest_blockers: This packet intentionally recognizes only the observed flat Claude counter names. An upstream schema change fails closed and requires a separately reviewed allowlist update.
A bounded authenticated Anthropic TUI retry remains required after this hardening; mocked gates do not prove a live account completion.
session_entry.rollback: Revert this packet-scoped commit to restore the prior recursive zero-accounting behavior. No provider registry, credential, terminal UI, durable route truth, or migration is changed.
